fato_historico: 1936: Rainey Bethea is hanged in Owensboro, Kentucky in the last known public execution in the United States.
energia_do_dia: Today may bring a powerful shift toward justice and personal closure. Much like a story reaching its final, quiet conclusion in history, you are invited to release heavy burdens from the past. It is a good time to embrace the warmth of your own light and walk forward with newfound, liberated spirit and grace.
frase_do_dia: True power lies in letting go of what no longer serves your bright destiny.
significado_numero: Represents change, movement, and the flow of personal evolution.
conselho: Consider letting go of old grievances to make room for fresh, lucky beginnings.
